name: egypt-public-affairs
description: Egypt public affairs engine for enterprises going global. Covers government relations, policy interpretation, regulatory communication, industry associations, public opinion, social responsibility, media relations, and crisis response — powered by curated reference corpus and structured databases.

displayDescription.en: Egypt public affairs advisory for enterprises navigating government relations, policy landscapes, and stakeholder engagement in the MENA region. Covers government relations building, policy tracking and interpretation (Egypt Vision 2030, investment laws, regulatory updates), regulatory communication strategies, industry association engagement, public opinion monitoring and sentiment analysis, ESG and corporate social responsibility, media relations and communications strategy, and crisis response and contingency planning. Corpus-first approach with curated reference texts.
displayDescription.zh: 精通埃及政府关系、政策解读、监管沟通、行业协会、危机公关和舆情管理，服务企业一站式公共事务咨询。
